# Block Generated File Edits

**Hook** · Code quality

A Claude Code hook that refuses edits to files whose first lines say they are generated, so the agent changes the source and not the output.

## Install

```bash
npx workspacetemplates add block-generated-file-edits
```

Or copy the file for your tool:

| Tool | File | Goes to |
|---|---|---|
| Claude Code | [claude-code/.claude/settings.json](claude-code/.claude/settings.json) | `.claude/settings.json` (merge) |

## What it does

Generated files get overwritten the next time the generator runs, so any hand edit is lost work. This PreToolUse hook opens the target file before an Edit or Write and looks at its first ten lines for markers such as @generated, DO NOT EDIT or Code generated by.

When it finds one it stops the edit and tells the agent to change the generator input instead. New files and files without a marker pass straight through.

## Use it when

- Protect protobuf, GraphQL or OpenAPI output from hand edits
- Keep an agent out of lockfile-style generated code
- Force changes into the schema instead of the compiled result
- Avoid diffs that vanish after the next codegen run

## What it can access

- Reads the first lines of the file about to be changed
- Blocks the edit when a marker is found; changes nothing itself

## Automated checks

- ✅ **No hidden text.** No invisible or direction-changing characters in any file.
- ✅ **No embedded secrets.** No keys or tokens; secrets are read from your environment.
- ✅ **No network calls.** The hook command works offline and sends nothing anywhere.
- ℹ️ **Runs a command.** Runs one Node.js command on PreToolUse for Edit, Write. Read it above before installing.

More: https://workspacetemplates.com/ai/block-generated-file-edits/
